svg.title: Жим гантелей нейтральным хватом лёжа — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. FLAT BENCH DUMBBELL CHEST PRESS WITH NEUTRAL GRIP. Both figures lie FACE UP on a clearly visible horizontal weight bench supporting head/back/hips, feet floor. Palms face EACH OTHER throughout, dumbbells parallel with ends visible. Left: dumbbells beside lower chest, elbows tucked nearer torso than normal flared press. Right: arms extend vertically above chest, palms still inward. NO floor press, no incline, no standing. Three-quarter side view. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
